why:
sets node name and namespace after open, because RFC-0046 makes LAUNCH the authority on node identity and an image is told its name at boot. rclrs fixes identity at `create_node`. See `c:support_init_named`.

phase-467 Row 11 follow-through (2026-10-03) -- CORRECTED. The reason read "rather than parsing argv (there is none)". A hosted build does parse argv now (#1591), and the identity remaps rcl reads from it -- `__node` / `__name` / `__ns` -- are REFUSED by that parse, loudly and by name (`nros_node::ros_args`), because RFC-0046 has not ruled on an argv identity rung. So launch stays the one source on every target, and this setter is where it lands. The verdict does not move.
